card.name: Final piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a brand drug name, such as the Y in BIKTARVY, IA in ZEPOSIA, A in QULIPTA, or ify in Abilify. It fires in drug label text when the brand name is just completed.

modes.label: Capitalized brand names
modes.description: Final piece of an all-caps brand name used in label sections on dosing, interactions and warnings.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of BIKTARV<<Y>> is one tablet containing 30 mg

modes.label: Listed brand names
modes.description: End of a brand name in a list of drugs, often after a generic name.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like drug, drugs and pill, which fits a drug name having just ended.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a brand-name medicine, once the name is complete.
